note: The grid harness's output, cell for cell, not a guess: `nim c -r --path:src tools/tune_baselines.nim --json` prints THIS file. Every cell of the matrix is played over both shipped variants and seeds 1..40; tests/test_crafter_driver.nim asserts the shipped DefaultBaselineParams still equal `pick`.
metric: total achievements unlocked by `forager` over seeds 1..40 of both shipped variants, ties broken by total survival ticks, restricted to cells whose certification-seed episode (seed 42, standard) survives >= 900 ticks and unlocks >= 6 - that episode is the CI replay the viewer soak runs against
